notes:
{牛|うし} is the general term for cattle, including cows, bulls, and oxen.

PRONUNCIATION:
- うし: standalone word for the animal
- ぎゅう: used in compounds (⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧, ⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧: beef
- ⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧: cow's milk
- ⟦{乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}→乳牛：24755_nyuugyuu⟧: dairy cow
- ⟦{子牛|こうし}→子牛：27912_koushi⟧: calf
- ⟦{和牛|わぎゅう}→和牛：27668_wagyuu⟧: Japanese beef cattle (wagyu)
- ⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧: beef bowl

COUNTER:
Large animals like cattle are counted with ⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧: ⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧、⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The ⟦{丑|うし}→丑：noentry⟧ (ox/cow) is the second animal in the ⟦{十二支|じゅうにし}→十二支：27602_juunishi⟧ (Chinese zodiac).
